product_overview: SmartShip Frontend is an Angular 21 web app for operations teams to authenticate, monitor and update package status on a visual board, and for admins to manage recipients and drivers. The MVP provides JWT-based login, a status board with drag-and-drop transitions, package creation, and basic admin management.
core_goals: Authenticate and maintain a persistent session so users can access protected tools.
Visualize packages grouped by operational status (RECEIVED, IN_TRANSIT, DELIVERED).
Move packages between workflow states quickly using drag-and-drop.
Create new package records tied to recipients from the board.
Allow ADMIN users to create, edit and delete recipients and drivers.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to authenticate with username and password and persist a JWT session so they can access protected routes.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill username input -> Fill password input -> Submit login credentials -> Redirect to /board on successful login
Navigate to /login -> Fill username input -> Fill password input with incorrect credentials -> Submit login credentials -> View invalid credential error message
Navigate to /login -> Submit empty credentials -> View validation error messages for required fields

features.name: Package Board Monitoring
features.description: Show packages grouped by status on a board and enable quick filtering and searching to find specific shipments.
user_flows: Navigate to /board after authentication -> See packages grouped in RECEIVED, IN_TRANSIT and DELIVERED columns
Navigate to /board after authentication -> Filter packages by selected status -> See board update to show only packages matching the selected status -> Clear filters and see full board reload
Navigate to /board after authentication -> Search package by tracking ID -> See matching package(s) displayed -> Clear search and see full board reload

features.name: Package Status Transition
features.description: Move a package between valid status columns using drag-and-drop with an immediate UI update for fast feedback.
user_flows: Navigate to /board after authentication -> Drag a package from RECEIVED to IN_TRANSIT -> Drop into IN_TRANSIT -> See package move to IN_TRANSIT immediately (optimistic update)

Navigate to /board after authentication -> Attempt to drag a package from DELIVERED to RECEIVED -> Drop into RECEIVED -> See validation error preventing the transition and package remains in DELIVERED

features.name: Package Creation
features.description: Create a new package record from the board by supplying tracking, dimensions, weight and selecting an existing recipient.
user_flows: Navigate to /board after authentication -> Open package creation form -> Fill tracking ID, weight and dimensions -> Select recipient from list -> Submit form to create package -> See success feedback and new package appear on the board
Navigate to /board after authentication -> Open package creation form -> Leave tracking ID empty while filling other fields -> Submit form -> See validation error for missing tracking ID

features.name: Admin Recipient and Driver Management
features.description: Allow ADMIN users to view, create, edit and delete recipients and drivers from the admin area.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin as ADMIN user -> View list of recipients and drivers
Navigate to /admin as ADMIN user -> Create a new recipient by providing required fields -> Submit recipient -> See new recipient appear in list
Navigate to /admin as ADMIN user -> Edit an existing recipient's data -> Submit changes -> See updated recipient reflected in list
Navigate to /admin as ADMIN user -> Select a recipient to delete -> Confirm deletion -> See recipient removed from list
Navigate to /admin as ADMIN user -> Open driver creation form -> Fill driver details -> Submit to create driver -> See new driver appear in driver list
Navigate to /admin as ADMIN user -> Select a driver to delete -> Confirm deletion -> See driver removed from list

known_limitations.issue: Application depends on backend API availability and does not include offline/mock fallback by default
known_limitations.impact: End-to-end UI flows fail when API is unavailable or endpoint base URL is misconfigured

known_limitations.issue: Board route is default redirect target even for unauthenticated users, relying on guard redirects
known_limitations.impact: Initial navigation causes extra redirect hop before reaching login page
